subject: Permanent Superintendent Search
overview: Candidate Lisa Kingsley discussed her platform regarding the upcoming permanent superintendent search in Medford and the role of the school committee in hiring and governance.

items.title: Role of the Superintendent
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley discussed the importance of the superintendent as the district's overall leader responsible for day-to-day decisions and setting direction.

items.title: School Committee Governance
items.summary: Kingsley defined the school committee's role as providing governance and setting priorities while hiring and supervising the district leader.

items.title: Superintendent Qualifications
items.summary: Kingsley detailed the state evaluation rubrics for superintendents and cited her own superintendent's license and professional background as qualifications for overseeing the search.

items.title: Permanent Search Process
items.summary: Because the district currently has an interim leader, Kingsley noted that a permanent contract search must occur in the next year, involving community input on priorities and hiring.
